title: Kratom leaf extracts exert hypolipidaemic effects via the modulation of PCSK9 and LDLR pathways in HepG2 cells.
authors: Nawaka, Nantiya; Lertcanawanichakul, Monthon; Porntadavity, Sureerut; Pussadhamma, Burabha; Jeenduang, Nutjaree
one_liner_zh: 研究卡痛叶提取物通过调节PCSK9/LDLR通路发挥降脂作用，仅含小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Kratom (Mitragyna speciosa (Korth.) Havil.) has been reported to reduce serum lipids. However, the molecular mechanism underlying hypolipidaemic effect of kratom is still unclear. This study aimed to investigate the effects of kratom leaf extracts on hypolipidaemia via the expression of LDLR and PCSK9 in HepG2 cells. Real-time RT-PCR, Western blotting, and flow cytometry analyses revealed that kratom leaf extracts from red-vein and white-vein strains increased LDLR protein expression but decreased that of PCSK9 via downregulation of SREBP-2 and HNF-1alpha. Furthermore, a confocal laser scanning microscope revealed that kratom leaf extracts from both strains increased LDL uptake into HepG2 cells. The bioactive compounds, e.g., mitragynine, quercetin, and rutin, in kratom leaf extracts from both strains were characterized by LC-MS/MS analysis. Mitragynine also significantly increased LDLR protein expression but decreased that of PCSK9. Molecular docking studies demonstrated that mitragynine had the strongest binding affinity for EGF-A domain of LDLR (- 7.57 kcal/mol), whereas quercetin had the strongest binding affinity for PCSK9 (- 8.45 kcal/mol). In conclusion, kratom leaf extracts from red-vein and white-vein strains possessed hypolipidaemic effects by decreased PCSK9 expression and increased LDLR expression through the modulation of SREBP2 and HNF-1alpha. Therefore, kratom could serve as a potential supplement for ameliorating hypercholesterolemia.
abstract_zh: 据报道，卡痛叶（Mitragyna speciosa (Korth.) Havil.）可降低血清脂质。然而，卡痛叶降脂作用的分子机制仍不清楚。本研究旨在通过检测HepG2细胞中LDLR和PCSK9的表达，探讨卡痛叶提取物对降血脂的影响。实时RT-PCR、Western blotting和流式细胞术分析显示，来自红脉和白脉品系的卡痛叶提取物通过下调SREBP-2和HNF-1alpha，增加了LDLR蛋白表达，但降低了PCSK9的表达。此外，共聚焦激光扫描显微镜显示，两个品系的卡痛叶提取物均增加了HepG2细胞对LDL的摄取。通过LC-MS/MS分析，表征了两个品系卡痛叶提取物中的生物活性化合物，如帽柱木碱、槲皮素和芦丁。帽柱木碱也显著增加了LDLR蛋白表达，但降低了PCSK9的表达。分子对接研究表明，帽柱木碱对LDLR的EGF-A结构域具有最强的结合亲和力（-7.57 kcal/mol），而槲皮素对PCSK9具有最强的结合亲和力（-8.45 kcal/mol）。总之，来自红脉和白脉品系的卡痛叶提取物通过调节SREBP2和HNF-1alpha，降低PCSK9表达并增加LDLR表达，从而具有降脂作用。因此，卡痛叶可作为改善高胆固醇血症的潜在补充剂。
